notes.title: New update - Happy lunar new year！
notes.content:
Hello friends,  The new year is about to bring a small update to *Deviator*. Thank you all for your patience!  Happy lunar new year！
Here’s what’s new:  

1. **SteamDeck Compatibility Update**:  
   - Native resolution support for SteamDeck.  
   - Removed unnecessary icons for devices like mouse from the PC configuration.  
2. **BossRush Update**:  
   - Added new powerful battle skills and charms to the BossRush mode.  
3. **Bug Fixes**:  
   - Fixed an issue where some charms' damage was incorrect.  
   - Optimized some performance aspects.  
   - Fixed a bug where the gacha machine would occasionally freeze.  

**New runes** (from left to right):  
- Dance of Lightning  
- Glass Sword  
- Overload 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44739655/f13e0ab66d0e3a851174ca0445ea0913a085ee56.jpg 

**New Battle Skill**:  
- Slam
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44739655/44e2a76a48d8b177d62a46bd3c2b6b03a22c44e7.jpg

Also, the Portuguese version has been implemented.  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44739655/a9296bf7cc139b93d4e699ea301628575bb36fdd.png

Thanks again for your support and enjoy the update!

notes.title: Deviator has now joined the Scream Fest!
notes.content:
Deviator has now joined the Scream Fest! The event runs from October 29 to November 5, during which the game will be on sale with an 11% discount (new lowest price!). 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44739655/05ed90c24204b7a37fd01f6748fbe3689813459f.png

The Metroidvania bundle featuring God's Wrath and Aeterna Noctis will also become more affordable, making it the best time to grab them!

Additionally, as promised in the first phase of our community update roadmap, Deviator will introduce a new Boss Rush mode this week. This mode will receive updates as new bosses are added in the future.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44739655/72496a26b1385e7bfdf74786ac46197611b43b43.jpg

After your first clear, you can head to the Mossy Forest area and find the corresponding room near the Mossy Forest Entrance save point to interact with a mysterious rock to unlock the Boss Rush mode.

Face the powerful beings reigning in the world of Deviator. Will you achieve victory or face defeat? Grow stronger through endless challenges and see who can conquer them faster!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44739655/b664b97918b85089745bd7419bb379df2a708c4c.gif

Recent Updates:
Boss Rush Mode
Added Turkish localization. Portuguese localization will be updated soon (thanks to community players for their support).

New areas and content are still in development, we appreciate your patience. We will keep you informed when they are ready!

notes.title: Important: DEVIATOR Early Access FAQ
notes.content:
Hello friends! DEVIATOR launched in Early Access (EA) on Steam as of 11 AM Beijing time on August 2nd. You can enjoy a 10% discount for the first two weeks. Don't miss out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2620730/_/

We acknowledge that the current version has many issues, and we hope to gather your feedback and suggestions through this EA period to gradually improve and update the game, ultimately delivering the best possible experience.

Deviator Discord Server: discord.gg/BwB8cetRUd

1. How much content is available in the EA version? 

  The game is currently in Early Access. Without considering full collection, the initial experience for the current version is around 5-7 hours. The full version is expected to take 10-15 hours, with more side quests, collectible elements, and game modes that will require more time to complete. Also, multiple endings can be experienced in the full version.
  
2. How can I report bugs or provide feedback during my gameplay? 

  You can report bugs via this google form link:Google Feedback Forum

We greatly appreciate your help!
   Therefore, the current EA version still has some known issues, such as:
  - Temporary missing sound effects
  - Temporary disappearing UI
  - Glitchy monsters (e.g., walking backwards, bodies landing in strange places, etc.)
  - Slow loading times
  - Brief joystick malfunctions

 Most issues can be resolved by restarting the game. 

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused. 
  
3. Can you share the future update plans for the game? 

From EA to the full release, we have a long way to go. On a smaller scale, we will gradually update features like Steam achievements and trading cards, and add boss challenge modes, rune-enhanced boss challenge modes, and fun challenging levels. Our main focus is to complete the full game content. Several major areas of the full version are already visually built, but the levels, details, new bosses, monsters, runes, and skills still need continuous refinement. As shown in the update plan below, we have listed the areas, expansions, bosses, runes etc. that we plan to update. If time permits, we will add more content. Please give us time, and we will keep working on it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44739655/516afe1f24f3052197681d1466cb7b93328c6154.png

4. Will there be Steam achievements and trading cards? 

We plan to add them in future updates.

5. Does the game support custom keybindings for keyboard and controller?
 
Yes, the game currently supports custom keybindings. You can change the key settings if you find the default layout uncomfortable.

6. What languages does the game support? 

The EA version supports Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and English. The full version will also support at least these three languages. We will consider adding more languages based on community feedback.

7. Will the price increase when the full version is released? 

Given the increased content and experience, a higher price is reasonable for the full version. We plan to raise the price when the full version is released, but this will not affect players who purchase the game during the EA phase.

8. Can I play the game on Steam Deck? 

Although the game has not yet received official Steam Deck verification, it can currently be played on the device. Due to the lack of dedicated performance optimization, you may encounter some slow loading times or crashes. We will continue to optimize the Steam Deck experience.

9. Will there be a Mac version in the future? 

Currently, we do not have plans to develop a Mac version. If there is a high demand from the community, we will consider it.

10. Will there be console versions in the future? 

Our priority is to ensure a great experience on the PC. Porting to PlayStation, Xbox, or Switch will require additional time and resources. As an indie team with limited resources, we will focus on perfecting the PC version first before starting console ports.

11.The Digital Deluxe Edition includes?

- The base game
- A soundtrack pack

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: "DEVIATOR" Early Access Begins August 2nd!
notes.content:
Today, We have released a brand-new launch trailer for our Metroidvania game "DEVIATOR". The trailer showcases the game's parry-based combat, enhance mechanics, and level scenes in greater detail. 

Additionally, it officially announces the release date and pricing that players have been eagerly anticipating.

The game will be available on Steam in Early Access starting August 2nd. The standard edition will be priced at $6.99, and the deluxe edition, which includes the soundtrack, will be priced at $9.99. During the first two weeks, players can enjoy a 10% launch discount.

Early Access Launch

The world of DEVIATOR was once under the protection of a "god," developing in an orderly and normal fashion. However, it is now in chaos due to an uncontrolled chaotic force that is gradually disintegrating and distorting the world. The protagonist, once called the apostle of the "god," is sent to eliminate the chaotic force and restore the world to its original state. But the truth is often not that simple...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44739655/ff9f8b75318241cf18de9a2b4b8114eaab67c997.jpg

In the Early Access version, the game will offer areas with different themed styles, from the lush Mossland, eerie Burial Grounds, to the ominous Underground Prison, serene Central Canyon, and the mechanism-filled Mechanical City. Several bosses await players' challenges, you can try to beat them with various combinations of combat skills and runes. The normal playtime is approximately 7-10 hours.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44739655/e159bebcb39e816a475e934a142de746f0dea53a.jpg

The full version release is expected to take about a year. We plan to update with more map areas, combat skills, runes, more monsters, bosses, and endings, with the total content volume expected to reach more than double that of the Early Access version, providing 15-20 hours of experience. Stay tuned!

Exciting Combat

The game’s combat centers around parry. Not only does a successful parry provide a sense of accomplishment, but it also offers gameplay benefits. For example, the unique "Enhance" mechanic allows players to accumulate energy through attacks and parries, pushing their limits. Characters will enter an enhanced state with increased attack range and damage, making the combat both visually appealing and satisfying. Compared to the Demo, the details of mechanics like Enhance and Parry have been updated in the EA version, offering a more balanced and comfortable experience.

As a challenge for players, numerous powerful enemies and bosses have also undergone iterations. These provide a more immersive performance, allowing players to fully utilize the parry features. Players will find joy in mastering the game through struggles and ultimately achieving victory.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44739655/11e5f49526a14835d2a9c4a4a8994b6eb30b3bbf.jpg

Deep Exploration

The EA version offers exploration of multiple areas, each with distinct scenery and interconnected paths. By unlocking new abilities like double jumps and wall jump, new routes can be accessed, revealing more secrets for players to discover.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44739655/b0aa2e797b881dba3f3cfd282d447fbeb3cda632.jpg

About GamiStudio

GamiStudio is an independent studio formed by five friends who share a love for Metroidvania, hand-drawn art styles, and parry combat. They hope to bring players a familiar yet novel experience in their first game.

With less than 10 days until release, add the game to your wishlist now to get it at a discounted price! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2620730/_/

Contact GamiStudio

Twitter: @GamiStudio
YouTube: @Deviator-game
Discord: https://discord.gg/BwB8cetRUd

notes.title: 【Important】Instructions and Announcements about Boss Challenge Event
notes.content:
Hello everyone! The Boss Challenge Event that was launched simultaneously with the game demo is in full swing. A large number of players have already obtained world rankings and are still practicing and refreshing their best scores. Thank you so much for your support and recognition to the game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44739655/d4a1c9f7ea6950be6ca481cd3bff6481e560eb03.jpg

However, we have also noticed that some of the records on the leaderboard are far beyond what can be achieved with normal skills and gameplay.

In order to ensure the fairness of the event, we have now removed some of the abnormal records. This announcement is an additional explanation of this event.

Criteria for determining valid records:
1. Based on the overall player challenge data of the current leaderboard, players whose final record reaches less than 36 seconds (including 36 seconds) are required to provide the recording video of it as soon as possible(by sending it to our mailbox: customersupport@sapstargames.com), otherwise we will delete it within 12 hours.
2. Records with very short time due to non-subjective problems such as encountering the game's own bugs will also be categorized as abnormal records.

Each player is eligible for a reward only once; while scores from multiple accounts are valid, multiple awards for the same individual are not allowed.

Appeals for deleted records:
If you have any objection to the record being deleted, you can join the official Discord

Discord: https://discord.gg/BwB8cetRUd

And contact the administrator and provide the video file of the corresponding record. We will review it and give you the result as soon as possible.

Thanks again to all the players for your enthusiasm and efforts. We believe no one wants to see their records achieved through hard practice being surpassed inexplicably, Likewise, no one wants their record to be regarded as obtained by cheating. So if you have any questions about the event, please contact us and we will do our best to ensure everyone's gaming experience.

2024/2/3 update

We have now discovered an issue that may be affecting player records in some regions.

The problem occurs in regions and countries such as Germany, France, and Russia, where the decimal point is expressed with a comma instead of a dot in the language, which can lead to incorrect program values and abnormal character damage.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused. The issue has now been fixed. Players who encountered similar problems please update the game.

Special thanks to "Chris", a player from Germany, for his help, which allowed us to quickly locate this important issue!

Lastly, we wish you all have a great time playing DEVIATOR!

notes.title: 【EVENT】DEMO BOSS CHALLENGE COMPETITION BEGINS!
notes.content:
After the demo launched, we will be holding an exciting Boss Challenge event the same time,  everyone is welcomed to participate!

Unlock the challenge mode
After completing the demo level for the first time, you will be given a guide indicating that the Boss Challenge Mode has been unlocked in the main menu. Through that mode, you can challenge the special-designed boss repeatedly, and get the challenge time record after successfully defeating it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44739655/aa72a48a9760b96c608cebd04c80337844009a97.jpg

Challenging for new record
Your records and ranking will be displayed on the global leaderboard immediately, and there will also be a leaderboard showing your friends' records. You can refresh the records by repeating the challenge.

We will count down the top 10 in the global leaderboard at the end of the event,  and provide prizes for these winners! It's time to show off your action game talents!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44739655/bd47f2a6bcd0e6ea83cde248a59ad86f0a25c6bc.jpg

Event Duration
After the demo release  ~ February 15, 2024 23:59 (UTC+08:00)

Rules
In order to ensure the authenticity and the fairness of the ranking results, players who participate in the event must follow several rules shown below:

1. During your challenge, please enable the screen recording software (such as OBS) to record the entire process from entering the boss challenge mode to the ranking settlement interface popping up at the end of the challenge (including ID, ranking and other information). Those informations need to be clearly visible in the video.
2. The use of any assistive tools is strictly forbidden.
3. After the challenge record statistics time expires(which is 23:59(UTC+08:00) on February 15, 2024), if your record is in the top 10 of the global rankings, please submit the corresponding video of it to our Email.

Email address: customersupport@sapstargames.com

We will delete abnormal record.If you have any objection about the deleted record, please send your recording video of it to our Email

You need to submit the video in 2 days, which is before 23:59(UTC+08:00) on February 17, 2024. The format of the email is shown below. If the time exceeds, you may not receive the prize.

*If obvious abnormal time records appear on the leaderboard, we will delete them directly without further notice.

Email format

Title: 

DEVIATOR boss challenge event + your Steam ID (the same as the name displayed on the leaderboard) + the ranking number on the settlement interface when the challenge success (if first place, fill in 1).

Screen recordings will be used together with Steam data to determine the authenticity of the record. Once unfair behavior such as cheating is discovered, records will be invalidated and deleted from the leaderboard, and the prize will be postponed.

*Postponement rule: If the second-place player cheats, the third-place player will be promoted to second place, the fourth-place player will be promoted to third place, and so on.

Prize（2024/2/13 update)

All the Top 10 players are guaranteed to get early access to the subsequent versions, and a key of the official version of DEVIATOR(after it's done). 
the Top 20 players are guaranteed to get a key of the official version of DEVIATOR(after it's done)

Additionaly, 
Top 1: Steam gift card $40 x1
Top 2: Steam gift card $30 x1
Top 3: Steam gift card $20 x1
Top 4: Steam gift card $10 x1

*Prize distribution time: within 2 weeks after the event ends.(Need to add Steam friend, please note the application).Each player is eligible for a reward only once; while scores from multiple accounts are valid, multiple awards for the same individual are not allowed.

In addition, the recording videos of the top 4 players will be displayed on our official Steam page and other social medias. The results of the other top 50 players will also be recorded in our game credits.
